macros.name: AnnoScolastico
macros.doc: \AnnoScolastico{⟨school year⟩} sets the school year at the end of which the state examination is undertaken; no default.

macros.name: IndirizzoMiur
macros.doc: \IndirizzoMiur{⟨Ministry of Education special address⟩} sets the Ministry of Education special address.

macros.name: NomeCandidato
macros.doc: \NomeCandidato{⟨heading over the candidate name⟩} is used to set the heading over the author’s name; since the “tesina” is individual, the default value is “Studente” or “Studentessa” depending on his/her gender.

macros.name: NomeScuola
macros.doc: \NomeScuola{⟨specific school name⟩} sets the specific name of the school; generally schools are dedicated to famous scientists or heroes, or presidents, or kings/queens, or writers, et cetera; default “empty”.

macros.name: NomeTesina
macros.doc: \NomeTesina{⟨document name⟩} sets the name of the document; the default value is “Tesina di maturità”.

macros.name: NumeroCommissione
macros.doc: \NumeroCommissione{⟨Examining committee ID number⟩} sets the examining committee ID number; no default.

macros.name: OpzioneMiur
macros.doc: \OpzioneMiur{⟨Ministry of Education option⟩} sets the specification that distinguishes the school mission, if any.

macros.name: Presidente
macros.doc: \Presidente{⟨chairperson name⟩} sets the name of the chairperson of the examining committee; no default.

macros.name: SedeScuola
macros.doc: \SedeScuola{⟨school address⟩} sets the actual location of the school; it may be just the city or a full postal address; it may contain new line commands in order to format a full address of several lines; no default.

macros.name: sottotitolo
macros.doc: \sottotitolo{⟨subtitle⟩} gets the thesis subtitle if any.

macros.name: TipoScuola
macros.doc: \TipoScuola{⟨generic school name⟩} sets the specific generic name of the school; default none; therefore use of this commands is mandatory; the user might specify “Liceo classico”, or “Istituto tecnico industriale di stato”, or whatever applies for the students’ specific school.

macros.name: titolo
macros.doc: \titolo[⟨shorttitle⟩]{⟨title⟩} gets the master or PhD thesis title and an optional thesis short title.

envs.name: FrontespizioTesina
envs.doc: The actual title page is created within the environment FrontespizioTesina.
